item.title: Wrong guess from Allgaier triggers massive Daytona 500 wreck
item.description: Justin Allgaier was delivering on the premise made earlier this week that he had a race car that could contend in the Daytona 500 when he made the wrong move to trigger a multi-car wreck.

item.title: Reddick surges past last-lap carnage to win Daytona 500
item.description: Tyler Reddick waited for the last possible moment to make his move—and it paid off with victory in Sunday’s 68th running of the Daytona 500.

item.title: Elliott didn’t want to throw too many blocks on Daytona 500 final lap
item.description: Chase Elliott wanted to give himself one last chance coming to the checkered flag in Sunday’s Daytona 500, and that meant not wrecking himself against the run of Tyler Reddick.

item.title: Keselowski had a shot at first Daytona 500 win until Herbst wreck
item.description: “The [No.] 35 just wrecked me out of nowhere for no reason,” Keselowski said. “That was one of the dumbest things I’ve ever seen."

item.title: Red Bull downplays pre-season pace: 'We are not the benchmark'

item.title: Barcelona to remain on F1 calendar in rotation with Spa-Francorchamps
item.description: Despite losing the Spanish Grand Prix to Madrid, Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya will remain on the F1 calendar, albeit in rotation with Spa-Francorchamps.

item.title: IndyCar finalizes schedules for Phoenix test, race
item.description: The schedules for this week’s IndyCar Spring Training visit to the one-mile Phoenix Raceway oval and next month’s return for the Good Rancher’s 250 race as part of NASCAR’s weekend have been set.The Tuesday-Wednesday Unser Open Test starts with a 12-5pm (Mountain time) run during which rookies will have exclusive...

item.title: The balance of efficiency and entertainment with F1's 2026 rules
item.description: Energy saving will be a major focus of F1 in 2026, and while the challenge for drivers will be different, it could deliver drama in other ways.

item.title: IndyCar to mandate two stints on alternate tires for street races
item.description: After a trial at last year's Indy GP, IndyCar is doubling the number of required stints on alternate tires on street courses this year.

item.title: Daytona delivers the most meaningful of moments with Reddick's victory
item.description: After a tough time off-track for Tyler Reddick, 23XI and its co-owner Denny Hamlin, the Daytona 500 provided a perfect start to the season for them.
